scope: Preparation only; no research model calls or human collection authorized

modelProposal.actualVersion: must be resolved and frozen at future launch
modelProposal.temperature: omit unless supported and prospectively fixed
modelProposal.seed: omit unless supported; absence is not deterministic inference
modelProposal.responseMode: one JSON snapshot; raw response always retained

isolation.required: Fresh model context with exact serialized allowlisted input and no tools/network, or independently verified restricted runner
failClosed: input plus output reserve exceeds context
isolation.engineeringBlindAudit: Procedural blindness only; shared filesystem does not enforce it

stages.name: independent initial
stages.inputs: own6 cards, common initial prompt/schema, D01-D08
stages.outputs: four raw outputs and validated-or-failed immutable initial snapshots

stages.name: deterministic comparison
stages.outputs: aligned plain/visual record; do not retrieve omitted facts silently

stages.name: bounded exchange
stages.inputs: all initial snapshots, comparison and full18-card union; one simultaneous challenge per agent, peers cannot see same-round challenges before freeze
stages.outputs: four immutable messages, each names at most2 claims, source IDs and proposed corrections; no extra discussion round

stages.name: revision
stages.inputs: own initial snapshot, all4 frozen challenge messages, comparison, full18-card union
stages.outputs: one revision per original agent, preserving its initial version and dissent; D01-D10

stages.name: interactive synthesis
stages.inputs: full18-card union, all4 revised snapshots, initial parent links and messages
stages.outputs: one source-linked interactive_final artifact; synthesizer is additional computation, not a fifth initial participant

stages.name: withheld evaluation
stages.inputs: that comparator final artifact, common rules, identical released withheld tasks; no development raw-source retrieval and no key
stages.outputs: one immutable transfer response per comparator

comparators.method: Deterministic bag union of four frozen initial snapshots; align identical predicate/arguments/source lineage and retain incompatible values, missing scopes and all parent IDs. No new inference, vote, new source retrieval or selection of best initial solver. Transfer evaluator receives this full lossless pool. Scalar readout and pool_conflict policy are fixed in SCORING_AND_ANALYSIS.md; it does not recompute facts across scopes.
comparators.rawEvidenceAccess: four private6-card packets initially; pooled reports only later, not omitted union facts

comparators.method: One fresh solver gets all18 raw source cards, common rules, schema, D01-D10; independent of quartet outputs. Output cap4096; no artificial evidence truncation.
I,C,E,R,S then T as specified; source union becomes available at E and is retained thereafter.
comparators.rawEvidenceAccess: private6-card packets at I; full18-card union at E/R/S

accounting.sharedInitialCalls: POOL and INTERACTIVE reuse the exact same4 initial responses; charge once in total actual cost, and disclose shared16384 cap in each attributable branch
include: all input/output tokens including reused prompts
cached tokens and billing categories separately
wall time and summed solver time
actual spend only if a later run incurs it
accounting.priceProposal: No spending or current price assumption; record actual provider usage/billing at future execution
accounting.retryRule: No semantic answer revision after seeing key. A transport failure may retry once with identical input, charged and retained. Parse/schema failure retains output and scores missing required atoms; no unbudgeted repair call.
accounting.contextRule: Measure actual tokenizer counts before launch. Include complete union/pool/artifact inputs plus reserved output; require <= resolved context limit. If not, refreeze a larger-context proposal or reduce format prospectively; never truncate sources.
accounting.comparability: Budgets and access differ intentionally and are disclosed. No superiority/interaction causal claim from this demonstration. A matched-information/matched-compute contrast requires a separate prospective design.

futureRepetitionProposal.status: not executed; requires future launch authorization
futureRepetitionProposal.allocationSchedules: Three explicit cyclic rotations, each repeated four times; each quartet contains all four private blocks once, with common anchors.
futureRepetitionProposal.analysisUnit: quartet/replicate, not individual card or repeated anchor
futureRepetitionProposal.purpose: debugging sensitivity, not a powered superiority study; report all outcomes and exact model versions
futureRepetitionProposal.allocationQualification: Each schedule assigns every block once; three of four possible rotations are proposed, so per-agent exposure is not fully balanced over all blocks. No general allocation-effect claim.

launchArtifactsRequired: public participant-only input manifests and digests
